Hi, I'm Suhe, a developer who loves technology.

About

  • Passionate about programming, exploring frontend and backend technologies
  • Love documenting lessons learned and sharing them
  • Tech stack: Vue / VuePress / Node.js / Java / Git

This Blog

Built with VuePress and vuepress-theme-hope, hosted on GitHub Pages with custom domain blog.xpww.cn.

You will find here:

  • Tech notes and development practices
  • Environment setup and tool configuration
  • Daily thoughts
